proposal.title: sanction-allow / sanction-penalize — did the authority permit it or punish it?

test_set.english: The banking commission formally permitted the lender to open office 9.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(banking-commission): the lender may open office-9.

test_set.english: The research board formally permitted the vaccine trial to recruit adults.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(research-board): the vaccine trial may recruit adults.

test_set.english: The borough council formally permitted the fair to operate on Fridays.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(borough-council): the fair may operate on Fridays.

test_set.english: The flight regulator formally permitted the carrier to serve Riga.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(flight-regulator): the carrier may serve Riga.

test_set.english: The privacy commission formally permitted the clinic to release anonymised images.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(privacy-commission): the clinic may release anonymised images.

test_set.english: The ballot authority formally permitted the coalition to register its slate.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(ballot-authority): the coalition may register its slate.

test_set.english: The harbour board formally permitted the freighter to use berth 8.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-allow(harbour-board): the freighter may use berth-8.

test_set.english: The protocol council formally permitted edition 6 to be distributed.
The finance board formally imposed a penalty on the broker: trades suspended for 14 days.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(finance-board): the broker, trades suspended for 14 days.

test_set.english: The ethics panel formally imposed a penalty on the laboratory: grants suspended for two years.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(ethics-panel): the laboratory, grants suspended for two years.

test_set.english: The athletics union formally imposed a penalty on the team: home ground closed for three matches.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(athletics-union): the team, home ground closed for three matches.

test_set.english: The competition commission formally imposed a penalty on the wholesaler: fined 3 million pounds.
The licensing board formally imposed a penalty on the dentist: licence suspended for four months.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(licensing-board): the dentist, licence suspended for four months.

test_set.english: The water authority formally imposed a penalty on the factory: effluent volume restricted to 80 litres daily.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(water-authority): the factory, effluent volume restricted to 80 litres daily.

test_set.english: The education board formally imposed a penalty on the instructor: barred from residential trips this semester.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(education-board): the instructor, barred from residential trips this semester.

test_set.english: The international council formally imposed a penalty on the territory: weapons imports restricted for one year.
test_set.ainglish: sanction-penalize(international-council): the territory, weapons imports restricted for one year.
